notes: The manual's parts boxes and several intermediate steps (3-7) are hard to read at this resolution, so the exact stud positions are best guesses. The piece identities and counts match the 34-piece inventory exactly.

Steps 8-9 show the leg unit (dark 2x2 plate, 1x2 brick, inverted slope) built twice and fitted under the body. The 3660 catalogue entry has only anti-studs, so the leg-to-body joints are modelled as the slope's anti-studs on studs of the lower body plates (b24, b25). The real orientation may differ.
The hinge sub-assembly in step 9 (1x2 brick, thin hinge top plate, dark hinge base) is attached to the lower body via the hinge base's anti-studs on plate b25.
The ears are wedge plates on the side handle plates (2540). Those plates are clipped to the black vertical clip plates on the back. The clip and bar pairing is inferred from the box art.
